appearance.extreme: Their head is mostly mouth. It hinges open past the ears, four rows deep, and there is a second smaller set of jaws further back that you wish you had not seen.
appearance.obvious: Their jaw opens further than a jaw should, and there are two rows of teeth behind the first.
appearance.subtle: Their jaw sits heavy and their teeth crowd forward.

description: Your jaw has rebuilt itself around the question of what you can eat. The answer is nearly everything, and the hinge goes back further than it should.
drawbacks: Eating in company is out of the question
name: Carnivorous Maw
